messages:
maya: starting a prod push for release/2026.03.20, canary first, tagging @karen-release for release notes link
aj: heading in 2m, heads up — deploy-bot errored out when I tried to kick off the canary
deploy-bot: ERROR: authorization failed: principal 'aj' missing role 'prod-deployer' (MFA: not verified)
sophia: ahhh we rotated the prod role last week, MFA enforcement tightened. aj — did you enroll new token?
aj: i have MFA but my yubikey is at home :/ was relying on temp crossover token yesterday
maya: can someone else press canary? who currently has the deployer kiln rights?
oncall-ryan: quick check — deployer role bound to group release-engineering and to the Deployer ROTA: @karen-release is currently primary
karen-release: I'm online, can press but want to confirm rollback plan & changelog first. also preference to avoid JIT exceptions if possible
sophia: changelog link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026.03.20 — small model pin, config tweak to batching, no infra changes
maya: rollback plan: if canary latency > 1500ms or error rate spike > 1% we rollback to release/2026.03.18, automated health checks will halt rollout but need manual press to rollback
karen-release: OK, i'll press canary but need a temporary annotation in the deploy ticket: note that aj attempted earlier and hit MFA — audit wants a record
aj: thanks karen, and sorry about the yubikey. i'll file a followup about switching to phone TOTPs for backups
karen-release: pressing now — `/deploy release/2026.03.20 --canary`
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout (5% traffic) — job id: job_1758888000_01
deploy-bot: streaming logs: warmup containers -> grpc warm -> model load 98%
maya: seeing first traces in datadog, latency nominal at 320ms :thumbsup:
sophia: adding temp exception to audit: `audit-issue: aj-mfa-failure-1758888000` in case security needs context
oncall-ryan: tagging security for visibility: @security-team please FYI, no privilege escalation, just failed auth attempt and manual press by rotation
security-team: received — we will posterize event and liaise if any gap
maya: if anything spikes i'll call for immediate rollback, otherwise we'll proceed to gradual 25% after 10m
karen-release: making release note update to include MFA note and ops steps: done
aj: thanks all — will sync with ops to update my MFA setup later today
maya: closing thread once canary hits 25% stable. good coordination :rocket:
